newsitem.title: UK: Williams sell-off to raise 350 million stg -paper.
newsitem.headline: Williams sell-off to raise 350 million stg -paper.

text.p: Williams Holdings Plc, the international industrial group, will raise 350 million stg ($558.7 million) by selling some of its building products businesses, the Observer newspaper said.

The price has been pushed up as three venture capital companies, CVC Capital Partners, Candover, and BCP, compete to buy the group of businesses, which include Rawlplug and Valor gas fires, the report said.

The Observer said the proceeds of the sale would be used to reduce the company's debt, which the paper said was 370 million stg. Williams plans to concentrate on buying high-growth brands with international potential, particularly in the Far East, it said.
Williams said no decision had yet been taken over the businesses.
